milestones.title: Virtru's systems-integrator team or XQ Message supplies sample containers paired with its own non-production key access server (owner action c); plan 45.2-12 then runs the acceptance trial with them

remediation: No vendor has supplied sample containers paired with a non-production key access server of its own, so the exchange cannot yet be checked against a second implementation; a sample paired with an unrelated key server does not count. Your organization asks Virtru's systems-integrator team or XQ Message for such samples (owner action c). The acceptance trial (plan 45.2-12) may use them in place of an allied test cell. Source: .planning/phases/45.2-nato-and-five-eyes-exchange-part-2-ztdf-and-the-nato-texts/45.2-CONTEXT.md D-23 and the owner actions; 45.2-RESEARCH.md section 10 (T5).
